end.summary:
Identified cube in a Ludo die and cylinder in a toy rocket.
Named cone and cylinder as parts of a spaceship.
Counted two flat faces of a cylinder, with one initial mix-up.
Identified a sphere and described it as having one curved face.
Corrected the idea that turning a cone changes its name; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects, and describing flat and curved faces. They used the “top and bottom” method to count a cylinder’s two flat faces; after a mix-up, they corrected the idea that an upside-down cone becomes a different shape. At home, ask them to name the shapes of three household objects even when each object is turned around.
